result.document_summary: A fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), covering cannabis regulation, flavored tobacco sales, and water/well provisions, with no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4 sections on cannabis outlets and production facilities, flavored tobacco, water supply and wells. The URL slug references an algorithmic rent-price-fixing division (98.1103), but no text of that division appears in this part. None of the content falls within the six rental-housing categories (rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application/screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting). The background-check provision in 42.1507 applies to cannabis business responsible persons, not tenant screening.
